title: Nine structural facts around the normalization of a reduced Nagata scheme of dimension 1
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The nine assertions are assembled from the delivered normalization lemma for Noetherian dimension-1 schemes plus finiteness of normalization for Nagata schemes, the ubiquity of regular loci (J-2) for the short exact sequence with skyscraper quotients, the identification of the length of Q_x with the delta invariant, and the completion relationship taken from the normalization-after-completion lemma. H2: assembly of delivered and named inputs into a multi-part structural statement, with the SES and the singular-point dichotomy as the glue.
